# XYGraph

<!-- Generated by js/scripts/widget-pages.mjs from the trait contract: edit the schema
     or the script, then run it again. -->

Data sets of (x, y) pairs with arbitrary spacing: characteristic curves, scatter plots (IND-115).

![XYGraph, light theme](../img/widgets/xy-graph-light.png#only-light){ width="428" }
![XYGraph, dark theme](../img/widgets/xy-graph-dark.png#only-dark){ width="428" }

**Recipes and plant structure** · [Widget catalog](../widgets.md) · [API reference](../api.md#anywidget_instruments.XYGraph) ·
schema [`xygraph.schema.json`](../trait-contract.md)

## Example

The traits of the picture above:

```python
ai.XYGraph(
    label="XYGraph (pump curve)",
    x_min=0,
    y_min=0,
    cursors=[{"x": 75, "name": "C1", "color": ""}],
    x_unit="m³/h",
    unit="m",
    size=(420, 240),
)
```

The data of the picture (samples, history or drawing) is sent with the widget's methods,
not as traits: see the [widget catalog](../widgets.md).

## Traits

| Trait | Type | Default | Set by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `size` | array | `[480,300]` | host | [width, height] in CSS pixels. |
| `value` | object | `{}` | host | Number of data sets and of points {sets, points}, written by the host with each data message. |
| `series` | array of object | `[]` | host | Data sets {name, color, style, width}, drawn in order. A set whose data have not arrived is not drawn; data of a name not listed here are dropped. |
| `x_min` | number or null | `null` | host | X range; null: from the data. |
| `x_max` | number or null | `null` | host | A number, or null when not set. |
| `y_min` | number or null | `null` | host | Y range; null: from the data. |
| `y_max` | number or null | `null` | host | A number, or null when not set. |
| `show_legend` | boolean | `true` | host |  |
